data.long_meaning: Ulisa is derived from the Greek name Ulissia, which means 'ulis' (ultra) and 'issa' (goddess of light). In early Christian tradition, Ulisa was considered a name for a wealthy and enlightened woman. This name is often associated with the virtues of faith, hope, and charity. The name Ulisa carries the meaning “Light, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ulisa usually hope their child will grow to embody light, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
